{{Youmay|The [[Five Worlds]] Minister of Justice|other uses of [[Minister of Justice (disambiguation)]]}}
The [[Five Worlds]] used this title for the government's civilian head of their legal system. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Denjax Teppler]] was the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] Minister of Justice.
